description.value: Il Nido is a well-regarded Italian restaurant in downtown Vancouver's West End, earning OpenTable Best Restaurant recognition for both 2024 and 2025 and a TripAdvisor Recommended designation. The menu leans into Roman and Sicilian classics—carbonara, cacio e pepe, arancini, lasagna—alongside a charcuterie board and rotating salumi. Both indoor and patio seating are available in a smoke-free setting steps from Robson Street.
